title: fraxinus excelsior var. nana
intro: Fraxinus excelsior var. nana, commonly known as dwarf ash, is a variety of the Fraxinus excelsior tree, known for its smaller stature and compact growth. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Fraxinus excelsior var. nana include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-microbial properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
